[My Lord](/person/1512),
Allow me to express my gratitude for the kindness of your invitation and of the arrangement for the journey. I must however beg to decline it until another year when I hope I may have the pleasure of making your [daughter](/person/1218)’s acquaintance under more cheerful circumstances.
I cannot at present feel inclined to enter on a large party, nor to leave my [mother](/person/1606), and I should be much obliged if you would allow me to consider the visit as deferred until some future time.[^2]
With many thanks for your kindness
Yours very respectfully

Charlotte M Yonge


[^2]: CMY had been in Devon in October, returning on 12 November 1867. This excuse to Bishop Wilberforce may mark the beginning of her mother’s decline.
